# Assets of the sheets game

Where every file of `assets/` came from.

| Key | File | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `ui.font-body` | `assets/font-body.fnt`, page `assets/font-body.png` | A byte copy of the mini game's font, itself a copy of the engine's `fonts/`: Pangolin Regular, MSDF, one 512 × 512 page. SIL Open Font License 1.1, the text is in `LICENSE-fonts.txt`. |
